description: This is a unit test class for ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactory, testing its creation, validation, and parsing logic for JSON field selectors.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit tests for ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactory class, covering instantiation, validation, and parsing of JSON field selector strings.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactory instances are immutable.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullString
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with a null string throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullOptions
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null options throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithEmptyString
methods.description: Tests that providing an empty string raises JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithStringContainingUnevenCountOfOpeningAndClosingParentheses
methods.description: Tests invalid input with mismatched parentheses.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that a valid selector string yields a JsonFieldSelector of expected size.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromSimpleKeyString
methods.description: Verifies selector creation from a simple key string.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromStringWithSubFields
methods.description: Tests parsing of complex nested field selectors.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromStringWithNestedSubFields
methods.description: Tests parsing nested subfields within selectors.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromInvalidEncodedSubFields
methods.description: Ensures invalid encoded substrings throw exceptions.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromInvalidParenthesisEncoded
methods.description: Tests invalid parentheses input when URL-encoded.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromInvalidParenthesisOrder
methods.description: Tests handling of incorrectly ordered parentheses.
